title: I Swapped Bodies with My Cat

lines.text: On Monday I woke up on the bookshelf. Nine feet up.
lines.caps: On *Monday | I woke up | on the *bookshelf. | Nine feet *up.

lines.text: I had paws. Whiskers. And a very strong opinion about the red dot.
lines.caps: I had *paws. *Whiskers. | And a very strong *opinion | about the red *dot.

lines.text: On my bed, my cat stretched like a man who slept nine hours.
lines.caps: On my *bed, | my cat *stretched | like a man | who slept *nine hours.

lines.text: He made coffee. Bad coffee. He put the mug on my keyboard.
lines.caps: He made *coffee. | *Bad coffee. | He put the mug | on my *keyboard.

lines.text: He went to my job and got promoted. I knocked a glass off the table.
lines.caps: He went to my *job | and got *promoted. | I knocked a *glass | off the *table.

lines.text: No regrets. The glass had it coming.
By Wednesday, he'd fixed my sleep schedule and my diet.
lines.caps: By *Wednesday, | he'd fixed my *sleep schedule | and my *diet.

lines.text: I'd caught two mice and forgiven zero people.
lines.caps: I'd caught *two mice | and forgiven *zero people.

lines.text: On Friday we met at the fridge, and we both knew: swap back.
lines.caps: On *Friday | we met at the *fridge, | and we both *knew: | swap *back.

lines.text: Now it's Sunday. He's napping on my laptop. I'm napping on his windowsill.
lines.caps: Now it's *Sunday. | He's napping on my *laptop. | I'm napping on his *windowsill.

lines.text: My bills are paid. My plants are alive. My laser pointer is missing.
lines.caps: My *bills are *paid. | My *plants are *alive. | My *laser pointer | is *missing.

lines.text: Was it a dream? Doesn't matter. The red dot owes me a rematch.
lines.caps: Was it a *dream? | Doesn't *matter. | The red dot | owes me a *rematch.
